description: Golden Q&A set for PolicyPilot evaluation. expected_doc / expected_section are matched against retrieved chunks for retrieval hit-rate; reference is used by the LLM judge for answer scoring.

items.question: How many annual leave days do I get per year and how many can I carry forward?
items.reference: 24 working days of annual leave per year, credited at 2 days per month. A maximum of 8 unused days can be carried forward to the next year; anything above 8 lapses on 31 December.
items.expected_doc: Employee Leave and Attendance Policy

items.question: Do I need a doctor's certificate for sick leave?
items.reference: Yes, a medical certificate is mandatory for any sick leave of 3 or more consecutive working days, uploaded to HRMS within 5 working days of returning.
items.expected_doc: Employee Leave and Attendance Policy

items.question: How many casual leave days can I take in a row?
items.reference: Casual leave cannot be taken for more than 3 consecutive working days. Entitlement is 6 days per year and it cannot be carried forward.
items.expected_doc: Employee Leave and Attendance Policy

items.question: How much paternity leave do I get and when must I use it?
items.reference: 10 working days of paid paternity leave, to be availed within 3 months of the birth or legal adoption. It can be one block or split into at most two blocks.
items.expected_doc: Employee Leave and Attendance Policy

items.question: What happens if my manager never approves my leave request in the HRMS?
items.reference: If a request is unactioned for more than 3 working days, the HRMS escalates it to People Operations, who may approve it on the manager's behalf if within entitlement.
items.expected_doc: Employee Leave and Attendance Policy

items.question: Who approves leave without pay and what is the yearly limit?
items.reference: Leave without pay requires approval of the Head of People Operations and is capped at 30 days per calendar year.
items.expected_doc: Employee Leave and Attendance Policy

items.question: How many late arrivals are allowed before there is any consequence?
items.reference: More than 6 late marks in a calendar quarter results in the deduction of one day of casual leave. A late mark means arriving more than 15 minutes after shift start.
items.expected_doc: Employee Leave and Attendance Policy

items.question: What happens if I do not show up to work for several days without informing anyone?
items.reference: An absence that is neither approved nor regularised for 3 consecutive working days may be treated as voluntary abandonment of employment.
items.expected_doc: Employee Leave and Attendance Policy

items.question: What are the password requirements at the company?
items.reference: At least 12 characters, no reuse of the last 5 passwords, no routine expiry but immediate change if exposed. Passphrases recommended and a company password manager is the approved storage.
items.expected_doc: IT Security and Acceptable Use Policy

items.question: Is multi-factor authentication mandatory and for which systems?
items.reference: Yes, MFA is mandatory for VPN access, corporate email, the HRMS, cloud consoles and all remote access. Privileged users must use hardware security keys.
items.expected_doc: IT Security and Acceptable Use Policy

items.question: Can I install software on my work laptop myself?
items.reference: Software may be installed only from the Company Software Portal. Employees do not have local admin rights by default; elevation requests expire after 24 hours.
items.expected_doc: IT Security and Acceptable Use Policy

items.question: I clicked a link in a suspicious email and entered my password. What should I do?
items.reference: Report it as a security incident to security@nimbussoft.example or the 24x7 hotline within 2 hours of discovery. Do not power off the device; disconnect it from the network and leave it on.
items.expected_doc: IT Security and Acceptable Use Policy

items.question: What are the data classification levels?
items.reference: Four classes: Public, Internal, Confidential and Restricted. Restricted data (customer PII, source code, financial records, credentials) has the strictest handling rules.
items.expected_doc: IT Security and Acceptable Use Policy

items.question: Can I paste customer data into an external AI chatbot to summarise it?
items.reference: No. Restricted data must never be pasted into unapproved external tools, including public AI chatbots. Sharing Restricted data externally needs an NDA and Information Security approval.
items.expected_doc: IT Security and Acceptable Use Policy

items.question: How soon must I report a lost laptop?
items.reference: A lost device is a security incident and must be reported within 2 hours of discovery to security@nimbussoft.example or the 24x7 hotline.
items.expected_doc: IT Security and Acceptable Use Policy

items.question: Who can work fully remote and who approves it?
items.reference: Fully remote arrangements are exceptional and require written approval from both the department head and the Head of People Operations. Bengaluru and Hyderabad employees otherwise work from office at least 2 days per week.
items.expected_doc: Remote Work and Expense Reimbursement Policy

items.question: What are the core hours when working from home?
items.reference: Core collaboration window is 11:00 to 16:00 IST; during core hours remote employees must respond to direct messages within 60 minutes.
items.expected_doc: Remote Work and Expense Reimbursement Policy

items.question: How much is the home office setup stipend?
items.reference: One-time stipend of Rs. 25,000 for approved fully remote employees and Rs. 10,000 for hybrid employees, claimed with receipts within 90 days.
items.expected_doc: Remote Work and Expense Reimbursement Policy

items.question: What is the monthly internet reimbursement?
items.reference: Rs. 1,500 per month for fully remote employees, claimed monthly with a bill copy. Hybrid employees are not eligible.
items.expected_doc: Remote Work and Expense Reimbursement Policy

items.question: If I buy an 8000 rupee monitor for work, who needs to approve the expense?
items.reference: Expenses between Rs. 5,000 and Rs. 15,000 require manager and finance approval. Claims must be submitted within 30 days with an itemised bill.
items.expected_doc: Remote Work and Expense Reimbursement Policy

items.question: When do I have to return my laptop after resigning?
items.reference: All company equipment must be returned within 10 working days of your last working day during exit clearance.
items.expected_doc: Remote Work and Expense Reimbursement Policy

items.question: Is the home office stipend clawed back if I resign early?
items.reference: If you resign within 6 months of receiving the stipend, 50 percent is recovered in the final settlement. After 6 months no clawback applies.
items.expected_doc: Remote Work and Expense Reimbursement Policy
